data.body: Update 2026-06-01: v4 merged. The shared rc_review_check_verdict (single source of truth for the poison-on-failure review verdict) now lives in lib/review-coverage-lib.sh and is used by review-coverage-invariant.sh + fp-recovery-audit-sweep.sh (2 of 3 copies consolidated). verify-session-provenance.sh G3 carries a KEEP-IN-SYNC comment at the verdict site. This task remains: extract the verifier's embedded G3 verdict + covering-PR filter onto the shared lib (the G3 loop is coupled to GH_BUDGET/_api_call_count/cache state), with regression tests proving identical provenance verdicts before/after. Still open.
